style: Warm, joyful hand-painted storybook illustration in the look of a 2D animated family film: soft painterly brush strokes, rounded friendly shapes, bright summery colours, warm golden light, gentle shadows, exciting but never scary, cinematic widescreen composition. The people are always the same: Tine, little Max and Oskar exactly as in their reference sheets, and nobody else. No text, no letters, no borders.

cast.tine: Tine, a cheerful woman in her thirties: shoulder-length straight blond hair, sunglasses pushed up on her head, blue-grey eyes, a big warm open smile, white sleeveless top, beige shorts
cast.max: Max, a little boy about three or four: short light-blond hair, blue eyes, round cheeks, a huge laughing smile, a light blue striped shirt, a grey bandana bib, light green trousers
cast.oskar: Oskar, a boy about five: messy light-blond hair, hazel-green eyes, pirate face paint (a red bandana painted across his forehead with black and gold squiggles, a painted black eye patch around his right eye, painted black stubble on his chin and cheeks), a red t-shirt with a black skull print, dark shorts; bold, cheeky and brave, a little pirate hero
cast.croc: the Beard Crocodile: a big storybook crocodile, dark mossy green, a bumpy back of hard grey stone plates, scales like wet grass, a big bushy grey-green beard hanging under its jaw, round yellow eyes, a wide toothy grin; big and grumpy but funny, never gory
